title: Tune TypeORM retry params for Supabase Supavisor
description: BE-BOOT-03 wires TypeOrmModule with default retry policy (10 attempts x 3s = 30 failed logins/boot on bad creds). Supavisor circuit-breakers the project for ~10-15 min after ~27 failures, blocking even legitimate connections. Recommended config: retryAttempts: 2, retryDelay: 5000. Already applied in the local working tree on apps/backend/src/database/database.module.ts — review and keep on commit. See bd memories 'supavisor-circuit-breaker' for details.

title: Fix double-envelope in /health/db response
description: GET /health/db returns {"data":{"data":{"ok":true},"error":null},"error":null} — the outer envelope is wrapping the inner one. The HealthController already returns {data,error} manually (apps/backend/src/modules/health/health.controller.ts:26), so an interceptor or main.ts setup must be double-wrapping. Likely surfaces when BE-BOOT-07 (response envelope interceptor) lands: either drop the manual wrap from the controller and rely on the global interceptor, or skip the interceptor for endpoints that already return the envelope (@RawResponse() decorator per plan).
